name: scene-dar
title: Dar
description: Yours to keep: a Goan house front in elevation, with a laterite wall under lime plaster, a painted door in a lime-white surround, a window of oyster-shell panes and bougainvillea. A key on a ring with a wooden tag swings in, catches on the brass hook by the door and sways to rest, and the tower bolt slides home. Quiet is a hairline elevation; playful swings the key and slides the bolt.
